# Credenciales

  body = list(
    jsonrpc = "2.0",
    params = list(
      db = db,
      login = username,
      password = password
    )
  ),
  encode = "json"
)

stopifnot(status_code(res) == 200)

uid <- content(res)$result$uid
if (is.null(uid)) stop("Error autenticando en Odoo")

# 👉 cookies como header (forma robusta)
cookies <- res$cookies
cookie_string <- paste(
  paste(cookies$name, cookies$value, sep = "="),
  collapse = "; "
)

```{r preparo entorno}

base_dir <- "." #carpeta raíz
dir.create(base_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

img_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "imagenes")
file.remove(list.files(img_dir, full.names = TRUE))
dir.create(img_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

csv_file <- file.path(base_dir, "imagenes_relacion.csv")

fwrite(data.table(
  sku = character(),
  nombre = character(),
  archivo = character()
), csv_file)

```

```{r configuro paralelismo (poder bajar las imágenes a la vez)}

plan(multisession, workers = 4)  # lo ajusto según mi CPU (4–8 ideal)

```

```{r función de descarga}

download_image <- function(p) {
  
  id <- p$id
  
  name <- ifelse(is.null(p$name), "NO_NAME", p$name)
  name <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", name)
  
  sku <- ifelse(is.null(p$default_code), "NO-SKU", p$default_code)
  sku <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", sku)
  
  filename <- paste0(sku, "_", name, ".jpg")
  dest <- file.path(img_dir, filename)
  
  # evitar sobrescribir
  i <- 1
  while (file.exists(dest)) {
    filename <- paste0(sku, "_", name, "_", i, ".jpg")
    dest <- file.path(img_dir, filename)
    i <- i + 1
  }
  
  img_url <- paste0(url, "/web/image/product.product/", id, "/image_1920")
  
  res_img <- try(
    GET(img_url, add_headers(Cookie = cookie_string), timeout(30)),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(res_img, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  
  if (status_code(res_img) == 200) {
    img_raw <- content(res_img, "raw")
    
    img_hash <- digest(img_raw, algo = "md5")
    
    if (img_hash != placeholder_hash) {  
  writeBin(img_raw, dest)
  return(list(sku = sku, nombre = name, archivo = filename))
} else {
  cat("⚠ Placeholder detectado:", sku, "-", name, "\n")
  return(NULL)
}
  }
  
  return(NULL)
}

```

```{r procesamiento por lotes}

offset <- 0
limit <- 200

repeat {
  
  cat("Procesando lote desde offset:", offset, "\n")
  
  res_batch <- POST(
    paste0(url, "/web/dataset/call_kw"),
    body = list(
      jsonrpc = "2.0",
      method = "call",
      params = list(
        model = "product.product",
        method = "search_read",
        args = list(
   list(list("image_1920", "!=", FALSE))
   ),
        kwargs = list(
          fields = list("id", "name", "default_code"),
          limit = limit,
          offset = offset
        )
      )
    ),
    encode = "json",
    add_headers(Cookie = cookie_string),
    timeout(60)
  )
  
  if (status_code(res_batch) != 200) {
    cat("Error en lote, reintentando...\n")
    next
  }
  
  products <- content(res_batch)$result
  
  if (length(products) == 0) {
    cat("✔ Fin de datos\n")
    break
  }
  
  # 🔥 FILTRO INTELIGENTE (ANTES de descargar)
  valid_products <- products

cat(" → válidos:", length(valid_products), "/", length(products), "\n")
  
  # 🚀 descarga solo los buenos
  if (length(valid_products) > 0) {
    
    results <- future_lapply(valid_products, download_image)
    
    results <- results[!sapply(results, is.null)]
    
    if (length(results) > 0) {
      dt <- rbindlist(results)
      fwrite(dt, csv_file, append = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  rm(products, valid_products, results)
  gc()
  
  offset <- offset + limit
}

```
